info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Account Statement Detail Retrieval API
info.description: The Customer Account Statement Detail Retrieval API allows users to access detailed statements for specific customer accounts. This endpoint retrieves relevant financial transaction data for a specified customer and account, facilitating transparency and insight into account activities. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions, customer service teams, and other entities that require precise statement information for auditing or customer support. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance customer engagement and provide more informed financial services.

get.summary: Retrieve Statement Details for a Specific Account
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed statement information for a specified customer account. By providing the customer and account identifiers, you can access all the relevant transaction details, balances, and other important information associated with the account's statement.
